name: Opaque Step
description: Move so that neither the line nor the tempo of the step shows in the body beforehand.

name: Cipher Palm
description: Strike with a palm that gives no sign of target or timing until the instant it lands.

name: Featureless Guard
description: Hold the arms with no set form so that a blow finds nothing to read or to break.

name: Riddling Touch
description: Touch the foe and plant a riddle of crossed qi that turns their next plan against them.

name: Obscured Intent
description: Hold a shroud of shifting qi round the body so the foe can no longer tell what the user will do.

name: Unreadable Gust
description: Loose a gust of qi that carries no sign of its path and strikes where the guard is not.

name: Sky Cipher
description: Cast a cipher of tangled qi over the sky above the foes so that each loses their sense of friend and aim.

name: Blank Verdict
description: Deliver a single blow of no school or pattern that lands with the weight of an unanswerable judgment.

name: Celestial Riddle
description: Pour the unreadable sky down over a wide front so that foes strike one another and their own ranks in blind confusion.

name: Pattern Nick
description: Nick the exact point in a foe's stance where its pattern repeats and shake it loose.

name: Pattern Sense
description: Feel which of the seven kinds of pattern a foe is using and where its seam lies.

name: Lopsided Step
description: Step with one leg long and one short to break the foe's expectation of the stride.

name: Torn Guard
description: Rip the form of the guard open at the moment of impact so the blow spends itself in the gap.

name: Fractured Cadence
description: Strike off the foe's cadence so the pattern of timing they depend on is cut in half.

name: Septet Rend
description: Land seven rapid touches each aimed at a different kind of pattern in the foe's art.

name: Splintered Rhythm
description: Hold the beat of the fight in splinters so the foe can never settle into a rhythm.

name: Pattern Annihilation
description: Gather chaos qi and loose it so every pattern within reach of the user is torn from its form.

name: Broken Seven
description: Break seven patterns in one blow of the arm so that stance and guard and rhythm fall at once.

name: Complete Dissolution
description: Dissolve every pattern of body and technique in a wide field until the foes can neither move nor cast as trained.

name: Havoc Glide
description: Glide into the foe's line on the back of a gust and break the line as it arrives.

name: Windward Jab
description: Jab from the windward side with a gust at the back so the fist lands before the foe turns.

name: Havoc Ward
description: Spin a ward of ragged qi that batters apart blows and jostles the hands that throw them.

name: Havoc Sense
description: Read the turbulence round a foe to find the weakest point in the guard of their group.

name: Rowdy Elbow
description: Throw an elbow wide and rowdy so it crashes through the foe's guard from the side.

name: Windward Mayhem
description: Loose a blast of wild wind and qi that tumbles those on the windward front into one another.

name: Havoc Snare
description: Cast a snare of tangled gale qi that snags arms and legs and drags the caught foe about.

name: Ravage Hook
description: Swing a savage hook that rips along the foe's guard and tears open the line behind it.

name: Havoc Squall
description: Gather a squall of wild qi overhead and drop it on the front rank in one lashing burst.

name: Ravaging Gale
description: Hurl the whole body into the foe's line on a ravaging gale that breaks guard and stance together.

name: Havoc Incarnate
description: Become the storm itself and unleash a ravaging burst in which every blow lands from a new direction.

name: Slow Decay
description: Touch a foe's stance with a drop of entropy and let the order in it begin to fade.

name: Patient Blow
description: Land a calm blow that wears at the foe's guard with a small steady loosening.

name: Cold Slip
description: Turn aside a blow with a cold quiet slip of the arm that gives the foe nothing to grip.

name: Unwinding Grip
description: Hold the foe in a grip that slowly unwinds the qi from every limb it holds.

name: Entropy Veil
description: Draw a veil of entropy over the body that ages and weakens every blow cast against it.

name: Ashing Palm
description: Strike with a palm that leaves the struck place brittle and cold like burnt-out ash.

name: Final Disorder
description: Spread an unhurried disorder over a wide area that eats at every pattern living within it.

name: Heat Death
description: Drive a finger through the guard and send entropy along the meridians until the body fails to hold its order.

name: Sapphire Undoing
description: Gather the cold patience of entropy and release one stroke that undoes the order of the target from within.

name: Churn Stride
description: Stride into a churning swirl of qi that hides the user from every side at once.

name: Heaven Jab
description: Jab upward and let the churn above add a falling weight to the blow.

name: Stirred Guard
description: Stir the qi before the body into a churn that tosses blows aside in every direction.

name: Sky Sense
description: Feel the churn of the sky above and learn where force will fall before it falls.

name: Convulsive Kick
description: Kick out of a sudden convulsion of the hip that throws the foe's guard wide.

name: Heaving Wave
description: Heave a rolling wave of churned qi outward that lifts and drops all in its way.

name: Paroxysm Touch
description: Touch the foe and set their qi into a sudden paroxysm that locks their movement.

name: Falling Chaos
description: Call a shard of the churning sky down on the target as a bolt of broken force.

name: Sky Snare
description: Lower coils of churned sky about the foe to bind their limbs in a tight tangled press.

name: Heavenly Upheaval
description: Heave the churning heavens down upon a wide front so the ground and air thrash as one.

name: Maelstrom Crown
description: Wear a crown of churning force that batters foes who draw near and grinds down their will to press on.

name: Heaven Convulses
description: Make the heavens convulse above the battle and rain broken force on both foe and ground alike.

name: Sworn Flicker
description: Flicker from line to line on sworn wind so that the user is never where the strike lands.

name: Gale Splinter
description: Flick a splinter of gale qi that darts left and right before it strikes the target.

name: Whipsaw Guard
description: Whipsaw the forearm across a blow in a snap that sends it spinning off line.

name: Stormtangle Grip
description: Take hold with hands full of storm qi that knot round the foe's arms and spin them about.

name: Rogue Gust
description: Throw rogue gusts of chaos wind that strike from the rear and flank of all foes ahead.

name: Vow Snap
description: Snap a sworn stance in two with a sharp strike where the vow of its keeper meets the qi.

name: Chaos Gale
description: Raise a gale in which every gust runs on its own course and none may be braced against.

name: Oathbound Storm
description: Hold a storm sworn to the user alone that tears at foes while leaving its keeper in a calm eye.

name: Gale Unleashed
description: Break the oath that holds the gale and unleash it as a storm of chaos on the whole front.

name: Wayless Step
description: Step along no way that wind or foe has marked and arrive in the gap between plans.

name: Rebel Palm
description: Strike with a palm that obeys no teacher and no stance and lands where it pleases.

name: Untamed Guard
description: Hold a wild guard that bucks against every blow and breaks all control placed on it.

name: Wind Sense
description: Feel which gusts round the foe are bound by oath and which are free to be turned.

name: Truant Jab
description: Jab away from the foe then let the fist play truant and come back from behind.

name: Unbidden Blast
description: Loose a blast that no hand seems to have called and no guard has prepared for.

name: Slipped Leash
description: Throw off any hold laid on the body and send the loosed binding back along its line.

name: Wanton Tangle
description: Cast a wanton tangle of gale qi over foes that binds them to one another.

name: Gust Mutiny
description: Turn the foe's wind against its caster so their own gusts spin back and blind them.

name: Unsworn Tempest
description: Raise a tempest that answers to no oath and sweeps through every sworn ward in its path.

name: Wild Verdict
description: Deliver a strike that no hand willed and no guard anticipated with the full weight of the field behind it.

name: Beyond Binding
description: Hold a state beyond all binding in which controlling techniques cast on the user simply fail to take.

name: Wind Unbound
description: Release a wind that no oath can hold and let it scour the field with chaos in every current.

name: Pitching Step
description: Pitch the body along the line like a deck in swell and come in under the foe's reach.

name: Slop Fist
description: Throw a fist that sloshes and shifts as it goes and lands with a heavy unlooked-for knock.

name: Heaving Guard
description: Swell the forearm against a blow and roll it off along a heaving curve.

name: Backwash Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sucks the foe's balance back as it withdraws.

name: Tumult Surge
description: Surge outward in a wave of tumultuous qi that tosses foes in all directions.

name: Riptide Snarl
description: Wind a riptide of qi round the foe's legs and drag them off their footing.

name: Rolling Chaos
description: Roll chaos qi over the foe in long swells until they lose sense of up and down.

name: Pandemonium Tide
description: Raise a great tide of pandemonium that crashes over the front and leaves foes thrashing.

name: Foundering Blow
description: Bring down a blow that founders the foe's stance like a ship broken beneath them.

name: Ruinous Swell
description: Hurl wave upon wave of tumult across a wide front until nothing standing on it keeps its order.

name: Gap Slip
description: Slip through any gap in a crowded line and be on the far side before it closes.

name: Stray Fist
description: Throw a fist that wanders from one target to the next and lands on whichever lags.

name: Dissident Guard
description: Turn each blow aside at an angle against the grain of the rest of the line.

name: Rift Sense
description: Feel where a group's shared timing is weakest and where a single push would break it.

name: Splitting Shout
description: Shout with a split voice of chaos qi that makes foes mistake whose order they hear.

name: Command Jam
description: Jam the qi that carries a call to a group so that each member hears a different word.

name: Unravelling Wave
description: Send a wave that pulls the order from every grouped formation it crosses.

name: Fray Beacon
description: Plant a beacon of fraying qi that spoils the shared rhythm of all who fight near it.

name: Fractured Host
description: Break the unity of a body of foes so that each fights alone in the confusion.

name: Panic Spread
description: Spread panic as a ripple of qi through the foes so that each flees or lashes out blindly.

name: Host Scattered
description: Scatter a whole host with one vast wave of discord until every fighter stands alone and bewildered.

name: Dissonant Step
description: Move on a step that rings out of tune with the foe's own and throws their pace off.

name: Jarring Voice
description: Speak in a jarring tone that shakes loose the sworn words a foe holds ready.

name: Offkey Strike
description: Strike on a sour off-note beat that the foe cannot answer in time.

name: Oath Wrecker
description: Hit a foe's fixed stance with a discord chord that cracks the vow behind it.

name: Chorus Break
description: Break the chorus of a group's chant with a counter-voice that clashes with every note.

name: Clashing Chord
description: Strike a clashing chord that rattles bone and breaks the concentration of nearby casters.

name: Cacophony
description: Raise a roar of every clashing note at once that tears the order from all within hearing.

name: Vow Unraveled
description: Pull every sworn word from the lips and the will of foes until the oaths they leaned on fall silent.

name: Voice of Discord
description: Sing the great voice of discord until every sworn form and fixed technique within it jars and splits.
